title: Conveyancing Legal Secretary
description:
Conveyancing Legal Secretary
Norwich
Mon-Fri, 9am-5pm

A well-established law firm in Norwich is looking to recruit an experienced Conveyancing Legal Secretary to join its friendly and supportive Residential Conveyancing team.

Key Responsibilities:
- Supporting fee earners with conveyancing matters and case preparation
- Drafting legal documents and correspondence
- Managing files, dictation, and maintaining accurate records
- Assisting with billing and client accounts
- Liaising with clients and third parties

About You:
- Previous experience as a Legal Secretary or Legal Assistant within Residential Conveyancing is essential
- Excellent typing and IT skills
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail
- Professional, approachable, and client-focused
- Able to work independently and as part of a team

Benefits:
- Competitive salary
- Profit-share bonus
- Bupa cash plan
- Enhanced pension scheme
- Death in service benefit
- Discounted legal services
- Generous annual leave entitlement
- Regular social events and a supportive team culture

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Conveyancing Legal Secretary seeking a long-term role with a respected firm that genuinely values its people.
